L.title: Storage choice exercise
L.content:
# Storage choice exercise
## Durable writes dashboard
Power loss alerts in the durable writes dashboard report previous incidents. The dashboard shows charts; it does not commit user records.
## Durable writes training
The power loss training module explains durable writes terminology. It only prints practice worksheets and never stores data.
## Power loss simulator
The durable writes simulator demonstrates power loss visually. It discards all inputs when closed.
## Durable writes glossary
Durable writes and power loss are labels in this glossary. This read-only glossary defines words rather than providing a storage operation.
## Storage operation
store_atomic commits each update to stable storage. Committed records survive an unexpected electrical outage. This operation writes records before returning. Do not use store_atomic on network drives.
